question: Can the source-bound 1580 Gyeongjin 正/月 shared-glyph occurrences be assigned to the official medium Inryeokja size class without overclaiming same-sort or same-casting identity?

national_science_museum.provider: National Science Museum of Korea / 국립중앙과학관
national_science_museum.notes: The institutional learning record directly couples the Inryeokja description with the Gyeongjin Daetongryeok example and states medium/small dimensions. It does not identify an individual metal sort or casting generation.

heritage_portal.direct_scope: The heritage record identifies Gyeongjin Daetongryeok as a Gwansanggam movable-type calendar and the earliest surviving book printed with Gwansanggam Inryeokja.
heritage_portal.printing_year_scope: 1579 remains an inference from prior-winter calendar issuance, not an image-internal imprint statement.

sizeclass_adjudication.explanation: The target 正/月 are the large heading characters in the 12EK source-fixed column, not the dense small body text. Given the institutional two-size Inryeokja control, the larger class is assigned to the medium class. This is a size-class assignment, not a metric glyph-body measurement or type-sort identity.

edges_rejected_or_unproved: same medium size class -> same individual sort
same medium size class -> same casting generation
same medium size class -> exact impression date
unresolved_lineage_questions: After physical-scale normalization, do multiple same-class shared glyphs show diagnostic type-form convergence or divergence?
Can specialist typographic research explicitly assign GK02538 to a named Gwansanggam subtype or casting generation?
Which securely pre-1578 witness carries the exact Sanming/Yueling Rainwater 後四日 + Dahan 十三後日 fingerprint?
transmission_impact.interpretation: 12EL closes the missing size-class bridge needed by 12EK, but deliberately stops before type-form/casting identity.

next_gate: Physically normalize additional medium-class shared glyphs across GK02538 and Gyeongjin 1580 before any type-form adjudication.
Recover object-level subtype/casting diagnostics from Kim Sang-Ho 1987 or equivalent authoritative typographic research.
Continue the independent pre-1578 exact Sanming/Yueling Rainwater+Dahan fingerprint and threshold-operator search.
